issue.title: Bug: SNMP tests take more time for running SNMP facts walk through for DUTs with more number of ports

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

For DUTs like TH6-128 with LT2 topo, due to the larger number of ports, 256 ports (_2x400G breakout config_), SNMP tests take lot of time to complete.

This is because, each test fetch SNMP facts for all the ports and this process increase the test run execution time overall as it takes place for each test under SNMP test suite.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run SNMP test suite on a DUT with large number of ports (_~180+ ports_)

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

**Actual Behavior: **

Each SNMP test suite takes close to ~1hour to complete on an average.

**Expected Behavior: **

SNMP facts walk should be done only once for a test module, not for each test case. This would reduce tests execution time overall.

resolution.title: [TH6-128] Reduce snmp-facts walk iterations to decrease tests run-time
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes # (issue)
This PR tries to fix the issue #23739.

Fixes #23739

On DUTs like TH6-128 where there are more ports, fetching SNMP facts every time for each test increases the overall tests execution run time.

To reduce that, for certain SNMP tests like 'test_snmp_interfaces' and 'tests_snmp_psu', snmp facts is fetched only once per module and used the same facts for all the tests under that module.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

- To reduce the SNMP tests execution run time.

#### How did you do it?

- Fetch snmp facts only once per module and use the same facts for all the tests under that module.

#### How did you verify/test it?

- Ran the SNMP tests with change above and noted a significant reduction in the test execution time for the above test suites.
- For the other SNMP tests, fetching snmp facts is required to get the updated information. Those tests are not touched.
